title.value: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
title.provenance: AN  ACT  to  amend  the  environmental  conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or  wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

status.provenance: The People of the State of New York, represented in Senate and Assembly, do enact as follows:

pfas_definition.provenance: "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: no person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances ...

date.provenance: This act shall take effect  immediately.

who.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes ...

action.provenance: shall sell or offer for sale ...

value: good faith reliance on manufacturer certificate of compliance
exceptions.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes shall be held in violation of this section if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer of such product

intentionally_added.provenance: person this state anti-fogging sprays or wipes polyfluoroalkyl substances as intentionally added chemicals
